subject: Re: Access evidence request — SAML/SCIM/RBAC artifacts
thread_content:
From: Emma Li <security@finedge.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Grant <procurement@finedge.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Access evidence request — SAML/SCIM/RBAC artifacts

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. As part of FinEdge's SIG intake we need to collect concrete artifacts for your access control posture. Can you provide the following by EOD next Tuesday:

- SAML metadata and an example SAML assertion showing group/role attributes
- Recent SCIM delta export (last 30 days) or a representative sample CSV with timestamps
- Role-to-permission mapping and a short writeup on how least-privilege is enforced for service accounts
- Any configuration/config dump that shows admin/owner roster for tenant scoping (redacted where necessary)

We prefer zipped artifacts via your secure Drive share and a short list of owners for each item. Procurement (cc'd) will need a timeline for contract diligence.

Appreciate it — Emma
Security Operations
FinEdge

-----Original Message-----

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <security@finedge.com>
Cc: Oliver Grant <procurement@finedge.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Access evidence request — SAML/SCIM/RBAC artifacts

Emma — thanks for the list. We're happy to assemble this. To keep things tight, I'd like to run this as a short evidence "sprint" with named owners. Proposed plan below — can you confirm the acceptance criteria for the SCIM sample (full 30-day delta vs. 2-week sample)?

Proposed sprint (deliver by Tue 22 Jun EOD):
- SAML metadata + assertion sample: Laura Bennett (laura_bennett@redwood.com) — will include attribute mappings and example assertion (redact PII). Attachment stub: saml-metadata.xml
- SCIM delta sample & sync logs: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.com) — will provide a CSV sample with timestamps and a short readme. Attachment stub: scim-delta-sample.csv
- RBAC mapping & least-privilege notes: Vivek Kulkarni — role mapping spreadsheet and a one-pager on service account scopes. Attachment stub: role-mapping-template.xlsx
- Admin roster & justification notes: Laura + Marissa — produce a redacted owner roster and a short JIT justification doc

I'll upload artifacts to a secure Drive folder and share the link to the FinEdge security mailbox. If procurement needs separate attestations or an SLA addendum, loop them in.

Vivek
Head of Security Programs (acting)
Redwood Inference

Adding a few implementation notes and timelines on my side:

- SCIM: I can export a 14-day delta now (sanitized) and run the 30-day export if they require it; the 14-day CSV will include: user_id, external_id, op_type, timestamp, changed_attrs. I will also attach a sample of our SCIM mapping doc.
- SAML assertions: Laura, I need the attribute name/value pairs you want included. We should avoid including full email addresses in the assertion sample—use hashed or redacted values.
- RBAC mapping: Vivek, I'll populate the role spreadsheet with examples of common roles (tenant_admin, app_deployer, support_readonly) and map to the internal permission IDs.

Proposed upload schedule:
- Wed 16 Jun: Preliminary samples (SAML metadata, SCIM 14-day sample) — internal review
- Fri 18 Jun: RBAC spreadsheet draft
- Tue 22 Jun EOD: Final zip to FinEdge with readme and redaction notes

Attachments: role-mapping-template.xlsx (will be fleshed out)

Marissa
Customer Reliability Engineer

Emma / Oliver —

Thanks for the timeline patience. We completed the sprint items and uploaded the package here: https://drive.redwood.internal/teams/security/FE-evidence-2027

Included:
- saml-metadata.xml (SAML metadata + README describing attribute mappings)
- saml-assertion-sample.txt (redacted assertion showing role claim format)
- scim-delta-sample.csv (14-day sanitized sample)
- scim-readme.txt (explanation of fields, export time window, sync gaps)
- role-mapping-template.xlsx (role -> permission id mapping)
- owner_roster_redacted.csv (admin/owner list with email hashes)
- least_privilege_onepager.pdf (control description and automated checks)

Acceptance notes:
- SCIM: if you require the full 30-day export we can produce it; it will need an additional redaction pass which adds 48 hours.
- SAML: assertion sample shows the role claim as `roles: [\"tenant_admin\"]` and includes an attribute mapping table in the README.

Please confirm receipt and whether the artifacts meet SIG acceptance or if you'd like the 30-day delta and the additional logs. Happy to run a short walkthrough this week.

Regards,

Redwood Inference
